headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 8, 2026**
article:
The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game, with Gerrit Cole leading the Yankees' pitching effort. In other action, the Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the offense and Gage Jump dominating on the mound. The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jack Leiter of the Texas Rangers, who has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle posterior impingement. Other notable injuries include Ben Williamson of the Tampa Bay Rays, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain, and Luis Urías of the Toronto Blue Jays, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right quad strain.

The Kansas City Royals made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. In other roster news, the Athletics acquired right-hander Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for outfielder Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Braves Fall Short in Bronx Showdown**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees edged the Atlanta Braves 5-4 in a closely contested game. Gerrit Cole led the Yankees' pitching effort, tossing 7.0 innings with 9 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Athletics Take Down Red Sox 7-3**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a 7-3 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Tyler Soderstrom leading the offense and Gage Jump dominating on the mound.

top_news.title: **Marlins Shut Down Angels 7-0**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins dominated the Los Angeles Angels in a 7-0 victory, with Sandy Alcantara leading the way on the mound. Alcantara pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Phillies 7-5**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 7-5 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Nathan Lukes leading the charge at the plate. Lukes hit 3 home runs, including a key 6th homer that scored Brandon Valenzuela.

top_news.title: **Rangers' Jack Leiter Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers right-hander Jack Leiter has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle posterior impingement.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals' roster as part of a trade.
